messages:
maria: Quick question — we're onboarding a customer for Private (VPC) and they want to use their own GCP Cloud KMS key for envelope encryption. What's the recommended SA/perm pattern so we don't use long-lived keys? (cross-project)

sam: Preferred pattern is impersonation: customer creates a SA in their project and gives it cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the cryptoKey. Then they grant Redwood's control-plane SA roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on that SA so we can impersonate short-lived tokens.

li: +1. Benefits: we don't store customer key material, rotation handled by customer, and tokens expire. Also ensure `roles/cloudkms.viewer` on the key ring if we need metadata.

maria: Can you paste example gcloud commands?

sam: Sure:
```
# grant KMS role to customer SA
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/KEY_PROJECT/locations/us-central1/keyRings/kr1/cryptoKeys/key1 \
  --member=serviceAccount:customer-sa@key-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter

# allow redwood to impersonate customer SA
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding customer-sa@key-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member=serviceAccount:redwood-control@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```

jon: Don't forget to enable Data Access audit logs for Cloud KMS (they're off by default). We need those in the customer's project to have proper trail. Recommend sink to BigQuery or Cloud Storage.

claire: Also request the customer to enable audit log retention and give us read access to the sink if we need to pull logs for compliance reviews.

maria: Rotation — if customer rotates keys, do we need to rewrap DEKs ourselves?

li: Yes. Rotation schedule can be set on the cryptoKey (`--rotation-period`). New versions won't automatically rewrap existing encrypted DEKs. We'll either call `encrypt` with the new key/version or run a rewrap job: decrypt DEK with old version via KMS, then encrypt with latest. We should provide a small rewrap utility in the private deployment.

sam: Important perms for rewrap job: the impersonating SA needs `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the cryptoKey (covers encrypt/decrypt for versions). Also need `cloudkms.keys.get`/`cryptoKeyVersions.view` to inspect versions.

jon: For cross-project, confirm the KMS key's location vs the workload location — cross-region calls increase latency. Recommend co-locating KMS in same region as data plane.

maria: One more — any objections to requiring customers to create a dedicated 'redwood-kms-sa' with minimal scope? keeps audit clean.

claire: +1. Add a short checklist for customers: create SA, grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on key, grant `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` to redwood control SA, enable Data Access logs, create sink.

deploy-bot: Action created: PROVIDE_KMS_ONBOARDING_CHECKLIST (#1234) :white_check_mark:

maria: I can draft the checklist and a small rewrap script. Will post PR in infra docs.

sam: Thanks — ping me when PR is up, I'll review the IAM snippets.

claire: Also add note about requiring customer to not disable the service account after onboarding (rotation ok, deletion will break).

maria: noted. Thanks all!
